title: unmeasured
responsibility: Records explicit unavailable latency and memory entries when no benchmark observed a unit.

inputs.name: unmeasured.unit
inputs.description: Registered unit whose exact owned source and runtime target define this observation.

inputs.name: unmeasured.testedRevision
inputs.description: Exact source commit associated with these explicit unavailable measurements.

outputs.name: unmeasured
outputs.description: Two entries with null values and explicit unavailable reasons; missing memory or latency is never represented as zero.
